notes.title: (Completed) [11/01 Patch Notes]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Greetings, Survivors!
[/h2][/b]

With the start of november, our team will be conducting an update on November 1. 

Please refer to the following description for detailed patch information. 


[b]■ Date and Time:
[/b]
[i]From
[/i]08:00 ~ 09:00 on November 1, 2024 (UTC+0)
17:00 ~ 18:00 on November 1, 2024 (KST)


[b]■ Update details:
[/b]

[Map rebalancing]
[list]
[*] In order to enhance the gameplay experience, a rebalancing will be implemented across all maps.
[*] Reduced difficulty of Wasteland.
[/list]

[Quality of life update]
[list]
[*] Removed Issaquah's gear score restriction.
[*] Reduced item loss on failed extractions for players under level 10.
[*] Fixed an issue where weapon flashlights would turn on automatically at the start of a round.
[/list]

[Bug Fixes]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug regarding the tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue where Korean text would appear in the character creation screen in the client set in languages other than Korean.
[/list]


[b]■ Event:
[/b]
[Medical Center]
[list]
[*] With this patch, Medical Center, a notorious hotspot known for its formidable monsters will be available for play.
[/list]


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][b](Completed) 11/01 Maintenance
[/b][/h3]

The maintenance [b](November 01, 2024 08:00 ~ 09:00 UTC+0)[/b] has been completed. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Demo version to be revealed on the 14th of October, 17:00 (UTC+0)!
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome survivors, to the World of the dead, where the line between life and death is blurred.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215824/fcab455b69892d428a74d7ed086a72e098392434.jpg[/img]


Our team is excited to announce that World of the dead will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest event! 

[b]On the 14th of October, a demo version of World of the dead will be available[/b] for those eager to experience our project firsthand.

The announced date and time for the upcoming Steam Next Fest are as follows;

[b]UTC[/b]: 2024/10/14 17:00 ~ 2024/10/21 17:00
[b]KST[/b]: 2024/10/15 02:00 ~ 2024/10/22 02:00
[b]PDT[/b]: 2024/10/14 10:00 ~ 2024/10/21 10:00

If you are one of the daredevil survivors who have been eagerly awaiting our demo, you are more than welcome to join us at the upcoming Steam Next Fest, as It will give you hands-on experience with the game’s core mechanics, controls, and systems, as well as a head start over fresh survivors in later versions of World of the dead.

Once again, thank you, and we will see you all in the world of the dead next week!
